title: Hire, fire, final - Chelsea's player power may be ugly, but it wins
summary: Chelsea are in another FA Cup final - but only after their players showed up in a way they were no longer doing for Liam Rosenior, writes Phil McNulty.

title: 'Four days of hell in hospital' - Kearns on miscarriage
summary: Aston Villa and England midfielder Missy Bo Kearns says she spent "four days of hell in hospital" after suffering a miscarriage and contracting sepsis.

title: Arsenal 'on a mission' - is another special season on the horizon?
summary: The Gunners are one game away from a second successive Women's Champions League final, and are also still in the Women's Super League title race.

title: Fernandez fires Chelsea to FA Cup final showdown with Man City
summary: Enzo Fernandez' first-half header gives Chelsea a 1-0 win over Leeds United in the semi-final of the FA Cup at Wembley Stadium.

title: Will doubters believe in Hearts' title chances now?
summary: Some have waited all season for Hearts to falter. Plenty thought it might be at Easter Road. But Derek McInnes' side are still going, writes Tom English.

title: 'Complete loss of control' - keeper punches player after being sent off
summary: Real Zaragoza goalkeeper Esteban Andrada punched Huesca captain Jorge Pulido after being sent off in a heated Spanish second division game.

title: Italian referee chief suspends himself over allegations
summary: The man in charge of assigning referees in Italy's top flight suspends himself after it is alleged he is under investigation for sporting fraud.

title: Win or bust for Rangers as Tynecastle trip looms large
summary: Defeat by Motherwell means Rangers' next game away to Hearts is win or bust for Danny Rohl's side, writes Kheredine Idessane.

title: Tactical stoppages need clamping down on - Murphy

title: Police 'aware' of video appearing to show York player punching fan

title: Newcastle interested in Jackson - Monday's gossip
summary: Newcastle are keen on Nicolas Jackson, Nottingham Forest eye Hayden Hackney as Elliot Anderson replacement, and Chelsea consider reuniting with Antonio Conte.

summary: Marcus Rashford is not ready to give up on his Barcelona dream just yet, writes Spanish football expert Guillem Balague.

title: How 10 Premier League teams can qualify for Europe
